Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend periods that occur in Canada during 2023.  
For each entry I’ve included the holiday name, the exact date of the holiday, and the start‑to‑end dates that make up the long weekend.  (Where a holiday falls on a weekday, the adjacent weekend days are included; where it falls on a weekend, the following Monday is added.)  

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Start | Long‑Weekend End | Notes |
|---|---------|-------------|--------------------|------------------|-------|
| 1 | New Year’s Day | 2023‑01‑01 (Sun) | 2022‑12‑31 | 2023‑01‑02 | National |
| 2 | Family Day (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | 2023‑02‑20 (Mon) | 2023‑02‑18 | 2023‑02‑20 | Provincial |
| 3 | Good Friday | 2023‑03‑31 (Fri) | 2023‑03‑31 | 2023‑04‑04 | National (most provinces) |
| 4 | Easter Monday | 2023‑04‑03 (Mon) | 2023‑03‑31 | 2023‑04‑04 | National (most provinces) |
| 5 | Victoria Day | 2023‑05‑22 (Mon) | 2023‑05‑20 | 2023‑05‑22 | National |
| 6 | Canada Day | 2023‑07‑01 (Sat) | 2023‑07‑01 | 2023‑07‑03 | National |
| 7 | Labour Day | 2023‑09‑04 (Mon) | 2023‑09‑02 | 2023‑09‑04 | National |
| 8 | Thanksgiving | 2023‑10‑09 (Mon) | 2023‑10‑07 | 2023‑10‑09 | National |
| 9 | Remembrance Day | 2023‑11‑11 (Mon) | 2023‑11‑10 | 2023‑11‑12 | National |
|10 | Christmas Day | 2023‑12‑25 (Mon) | 2023‑12‑23 | 2023‑12‑25 | National |
|11 | Boxing Day | 2023‑12‑26 (Tue) | 2023‑12‑24 | 2023‑12‑26 | National (federal & some provinces) |
